title: Blåbär

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Blåbär is a character found in Meadows. It is a tamed Lox that accompanies Hildir at her trading camp.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: Nothing is known about Blåbär beyond the fact it is a Lox that resides with Hildir in her camp feeding from a bowl alongside Hallon.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• "Blåbär" is a swedish word, meaning blueberry. It is derived from blå "blue" and bär "berry". Blåbär doesn't refer to the North American blueberry (Vaccinium cyanococcus), but to a related fruit called "bilberry" (Vaccinium myrtillus) "Blåbärssoppa" is a soup made from said fruit.
• Blåbär and Hallon can be pet.
